All production local imports and entrypoint specifiers resolve within extensions/a2a. No plugin-owned/shared shipped source leaves that boundary. package.json points to index.ts, setup-entry.ts, api.ts and runtime-api.ts and declares no generated-source or build-output scope exception. Other local barrels reexport plugin-owned objects, runtime-store return functions, or composite types and do not invent SDK export identities.

defineBundledChannelEntry and defineBundledChannelSetupEntry own registration internally. Their calls are SDK-export uses; a2a source contains no direct OpenClawPluginApi handle access or named hook registration to enumerate.

createPluginRuntimeStore<PluginRuntime> proves the getA2aChannelRuntime handle. gateway.ts independently reads runtime.channel and runtime.version, casts the channel handle as PluginRuntime["channel"], and forwards that handle to inbound.ts. The indexed channel type and independent channel read establish runtime.channel without adding a runtime root finding.

gateway.ts passes channelRuntime.inbound.buildContext unchanged to inbound.ts, establishing a runtime member-access followed by a call. The separately imported buildChannelInboundEventContext is used only in typeof type syntax: ordinary value import plus explicit type reference is mixed, and signature compatibility does not turn the supplied runtime function into an alias of the free SDK export.

ChannelGatewayContext is a channel adapter context, not OpenClawPluginApi: ctx.cfg, ctx.setStatus, ctx.abortSignal and other context fields are not API-member identities. Plugin-owned account/config/task-store/protocol structures and SDK helper return values (including envelope builders, ingress/dispatch results, SSRF leases and schema/status adapters) likewise do not become API/runtime handles.
Manifest channels declares a2a. Categories, activation, channelConfigs, configSchema and package channel setup descriptions are outside the agreed manifest-contract identity fields.
